title: This Snake Tricks Fish Into Fleeing Straight Into Its Mouth
subject: tentacled snake

scenes.text: This snake makes fish run away from it. And they swim straight into its mouth.
It hangs in the water bent like the letter J and waits. Then it twitches its body, too small to see.
That twitch sets off a fish's panic reflex, a turn that takes under ten milliseconds.
Fish are wired to flee away from a threat. The twitch tricks them into turning toward the head.
In tests, fish turned toward the snake's head 78 percent of the time. The strike takes about forty milliseconds.
The prey runs for its life, and runs into the jaws.

description:
The tentacled snake twitches its body to trigger a fish's escape reflex, so the fish flees toward its mouth.
In tests, fish turned toward the snake's head 78 percent of the time.
What other animal has the cleverest trick?
thumbnail_text: THE SNAKE THAT MAKES FISH PANIC
first_comment: Newborn tentacled snakes made these predictive strikes too, so the trick seems to be inborn, not learned. Which animal has the smartest hunting trick?
